description: List UN SDG monitoring indicators with their series codes, tier classifications (Tier I = established methodology, Tier II = methodology in development, Tier III = no agreed methodology), and associated data series codes. Optionally filter by goal (1–17) or target (e.g. "3.3"). Series codes (e.g. "SI_POV_DAY1", "SH_STA_MORT") are the inputs to unsdg.data.query for fetching actual country-level time series data.

goal.description: Filter indicators by SDG goal number (e.g. "1", "3", "13"). If omitted, all 231 indicators across all 17 goals are returned.

target.description: Filter indicators by target code (e.g. "1.1", "3.3", "13.2"). Requires goal to be set for best results.

name: unsdg.indicators.list

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: UN SDG Indicators
